about.description: BELIF represents a tokenized share in Bosera Liquidity Income Fund SP, designed to provide USD-denominated income from a portfolio of short-duration, high-quality fixed income and money market instruments. The digital share format is intended to support more programmable subscriptions, redemptions, and potential secondary transfers than conventional fund shares, while preserving a familiar fund wrapper for the underlying exposure. It is positioned as an onchain-accessible cash management and income sleeve backed by Bosera's regulated asset management platform.
